title: Verify audit log returns business-readable change labels for full rule lifecycle

steps.action: Call GET /rules/{ruleId}/audit and validate every returned entry has change_type and business-readable change_type_description.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK. Each audit row contains the expected AC label and does not expose only the raw enum value.

title: Verify audit endpoint rejects unauthenticated request

steps.action: Send GET audit request without token.
steps.expected: Response is 401 Unauthorized and no audit details are returned.

title: Verify audit endpoint enforces tenant isolation for rule audit logs

steps.action: Call GET audit for a rule owned by another tenant using a different tenant token.
steps.expected: Response is 404 Not Found or equivalent tenant-scoped not visible response. No other tenant audit data is returned.

title: Verify CSV audit export contains change_type_description column and business labels

steps.action: Request CSV export and inspect header row and body rows.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK with text/csv content type. CSV includes change_type_description column and business labels.

title: Verify PDF audit export returns a valid PDF file

steps.action: Request PDF export and validate response headers and file structure.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK with application/pdf content type and non-empty PDF payload.

title: Verify Excel audit export returns a valid XLSX file

steps.action: Request Excel audit export and validate workbook can be opened and has expected audit columns.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK with XLSX content type and workbook contains audit rows with business labels.

title: Verify JSON audit export matches audit response schema

steps.action: Request JSON export and compare key fields with GET audit schema.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK with application/json content type and array of audit log objects.

title: Verify audit export rejects invalid format parameter

steps.action: Call export using an unsupported format value.
steps.expected: Response is 400 Bad Request with invalid export format error.

title: Verify audit export supports valid date range filtering

steps.action: Request JSON export with from_date and to_date and validate changed_at values.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK and all exported rows have changed_at within the inclusive date range.

title: Verify audit export rejects invalid date range

steps.action: Call export with from_date later than to_date.
steps.expected: Response is 400 Bad Request with invalid date range error.

title: Verify version history returns snapshots in ascending version order

steps.action: Call GET /versions and inspect the sequence of version_number values.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK and versions are ordered from lowest to highest version_number.

title: Verify specific version snapshot returns complete snapshot fields

steps.action: Call GET /versions/{versionNumber} and validate required response fields.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK and snapshot fields match the stored version data.

title: Verify missing version number returns not found

steps.action: Call GET specific version using a version number that does not exist for the rule.
steps.expected: Response is 404 Not Found with VERSION_NOT_FOUND detail.

title: Verify compare versions returns field-level differences

steps.action: Compare two different versions and validate differences array.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK. differences contains each changed field with values for both versions and accurate difference_count.

title: Verify compare same version returns no differences

steps.action: Call compare with the same version number for both query params.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK with differences=[] and difference_count=0.

title: Verify compare endpoint rejects missing query parameters

steps.action: Call compare endpoint with one required query parameter missing.
steps.expected: Response is 400 Bad Request with compare parameter required validation.

title: Verify compare endpoint handles reversed version order

steps.action: Compare versions using reversed order and validate response consistency.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK. version_a/version_b reflect requested versions or normalized ordering as documented, and differences are accurate.

title: Verify rollback to prior version creates a new version without overwriting history

steps.action: Submit rollback request and then query version history.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK. New version_number equals previous max+1, content matches target version, prior versions remain queryable.

title: Verify rollback creates RolledBack audit log with business reason

steps.action: Query audit log after rollback and locate latest RolledBack entry.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK and audit entry includes change_type_description=Rolled Back to Prior Version and the provided business_reason.

title: Verify rollback is blocked when rule is active

steps.action: Attempt rollback on an Active rule.
steps.expected: Response is 422 Unprocessable Entity with CANNOT_ROLLBACK_ACTIVE_RULE. No new version or rollback audit entry is created.

title: Verify rollback rejects nonexistent target version

steps.action: Submit rollback using a target version that does not exist.
steps.expected: Response is 422 Unprocessable Entity with VERSION_NOT_FOUND and no new version is created.

title: Verify rollback rejects empty business reason

steps.action: Submit rollback request with empty business_reason.
steps.expected: Response is 400 Bad Request with BUSINESS_REASON_REQUIRED validation.

title: Verify rollback rejects business reason over 1000 characters

steps.action: Submit rollback request with a business reason longer than allowed.
steps.expected: Response is 400 Bad Request with BUSINESS_REASON_TOO_LONG validation.

title: Verify rollback requires rule.manage policy

steps.action: Attempt rollback using a token that has only monitor/read permission.
steps.expected: Response is 403 Forbidden and no new version or audit entry is created.

title: Verify rollback rejects invalid target version number zero or negative

steps.action: Submit rollback request with zero or negative target_version_number.
steps.expected: Response is 400 Bad Request with INVALID_VERSION_NUMBER validation.

title: Verify audit and version resources are immutable through API surface

steps.action: Review Swagger/OpenAPI paths for audit and version snapshot endpoints.
steps.expected: No API endpoint supports updating or deleting audit entries or version snapshots. Any direct attempt returns 404/405.

title: Verify duplicate version snapshot is not allowed by unique constraint

steps.action: Attempt duplicate snapshot creation for an existing rule version.
steps.expected: Duplicate snapshot is rejected by service or database unique constraint; existing snapshot remains unchanged.

title: Verify export with no audit results returns valid empty file response

steps.action: Request audit export for a valid rule/date range with no matching audit rows.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK with an empty JSON array or valid file containing headers only, depending on selected format.

title: Verify audit export performance for regulatory-sized audit history

steps.action: Request CSV export for a rule with large audit history and measure response time.
steps.expected: Response is 200 OK and completes within the agreed SLA; CSV remains well-formed.

title: Verify audit and version endpoints return 404 for unknown rule identifier

steps.action: Call version or audit endpoint using a syntactically valid but nonexistent rule identifier.
steps.expected: Response is 404 Not Found with RULE_NOT_FOUND detail and no audit/version data is returned.
